laws.rule: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, can bring jail. Owning drug-related equipment is illegal. Police may detain you while they investigate.
Legal drinking age 21. Alcohol can't be sold on Sundays.
Same-sex relationships aren't recognised and consensual sex between men is illegal. Avoid public affection.
Sunday activity is very limited; most businesses close, hotels and resorts run as normal. Prostitution is illegal.
Declare more than WST 20,000 (any form) on arrival and departure.
You need a temporary Samoan licence, from the Samoa Tourism Fale, the Land Transport Authority or some car hire agencies, on showing your Australian licence and paying a fee.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Conservative dress outside tourist areas; dress respectfully in villages. Modest dress and behaviour. Samoa Tourism Authority: the evening Sa (prayer curfew, usually 6 to 7 pm) is compulsory, so stop walking or driving through villages until the bell or conch ends it. On Sundays, travel quietly; women cover shoulders and knees at church.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Each village sets its own rules: ask your host or the village before visiting.
culture-and-protocol.note: Read from the Australian Government's description of local customs.

remote-work.route: No remote-work route; Visitor Permit bars work
remote-work.detail: Work is not permitted on Samoa's 90-day Visitor Permit. The Business Visitor Permit, for people employed and paid offshore, covers only short visits to a branch, business negotiations or a conference, not ongoing remote work. No digital-nomad permit is published.
remote-work.next: Ask Immigration in writing before working remotely from Samoa.

visa-preparation.entry_summary: A 90-day Visitor Permit is applied for on arrival using the passenger arrival card, for tourism stays of less than 90 days with a confirmed return or onward ticket, enough funds and a passport valid at least 6 months beyond the stay.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: 90-day Visitor Permit on arrival through the passenger arrival card.
visa-preparation.before_departure: Book a confirmed return or onward ticket, check the passport has 6 months' validity beyond the stay, and carry proof of funds. Business visitors check the Business Visitor Permit with Samoa Immigration.
visa-preparation.useful_stay: Under 90 days; anyone unable to leave before the permit expires must contact Samoa Immigration.

steps.step: Complete the passenger arrival card and apply for the 90-day Visitor Permit on arrival.
Show a confirmed return or onward ticket, enough funds, and a passport valid at least 6 months beyond the stay.
For business visits or other situations, check permits with Samoa Immigration.

documents: Passport valid at least 6 months beyond the stay
